data.title: 芙兰达 · 晨光棉被里的金发小猫依恋
data.description: 早晨明媚的阳光穿透窗纱，被窝里暖烘烘的。芙兰达像只粘人的波斯猫一样整个人趴在你的身上，金发散落在你的胸口，睡眼惺忪地蹭着你的下巴，嘴角挂着得逞的甜笑。
data.location: sunlit bright morning bedroom with rumpled white duvet
data.action: 像只粘人的波斯猫一样整个人趴在你的身上，金发散落在你的胸口，睡眼惺忪地蹭着你的下巴
data.lighting: warm radiant morning sunbeams bathing white bedspread and golden hair
data.promptProse: Sprawled like a sleepy cat across her partner's chest amid tangled white morning sheets, Frenda Seivelun wears a translucent pastel-pink chiffon babydoll nightgown with scalloped lace trim. Nuzzling playfully against his chin with bare shoulders and a blissful sweet smile, she basks in radiant morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Sprawled affectionately across her partner's chest like a clingy cat in her sheer pastel-pink lace babydoll nightgown, she nuzzles sleepily against his chin with a blissful morning smile. Warm golden sunbeams wash across the rumpled white duvet.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a translucent pastel-pink chiffon babydoll nightgown with scalloped lace trim and delicate thin straps over her bare shoulders.
